title: Coca-Cola suspended production at its Fairlife dairy after a ransomware attack
slides: Did a ransomware attack freeze Coca-Cola's Fairlife supply chain?
Production at the Fairlife dairy remains fully suspended.
The attack hit internal systems, not just the bottling line.
Your grocery store shelves could see Fairlife shortages soon.
Verify your supplier's cyber defenses before the next disruption.
thread_text:
1. Has ransomware hit Fairlife?

Production at the Fairlife dairy is fully suspended after the attack locked internal systems.

2. Not just a bottling glitch.

The ransomware hit far deeper than the bottling line—internal systems were compromised too.

3. Grocery shelves next casualty.

Expect shortages on store shelves soon as supply grinds to a halt.

4. Supplier cyber gaps exposed.

This attack reveals how one weak link in your supply chain can freeze operations.

5. Check your supplier’s defenses.

Call your key suppliers today and ask for their last cyber audit. Have you verified their resilience?
